name: @zhizhu/playwright-browser-fingerprint
description: 知竹：Playwright 类真实设备指纹（Electron headed-login / 采集 Runner 同源复用）

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const cp=require('node:child_process');const hasTsc=(()=>{try{return !!require.resolve('typescript/bin/tsc')}catch{return false}})();if(!hasTsc){console.log('[playwright-browser-fingerprint] skip build: typescript not installed');process.exit(0);}cp.execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});"
